title: Truck vs Car: force kis par zyada?
description: Season 2 Episode 10: In any collision both bodies feel exactly equal force; the damage difference comes from acceleration = F/m.
ncert_chapter: NCERT XI Ch 4 (3rd law + a = F/m)
hook_text: Truck 🚛 vs Car 🚗 — force kis par ZYADA?
concept: In any collision both bodies feel exactly equal force; the damage difference comes from acceleration = F/m.
on_screen_cues: "F_truck→car = F_car→truck" → "a = F/m" with 10,000 kg vs 1,000 kg → "Same force, 10× acceleration" → "NCERT XI Ch 4"
pinned_comment: Mosquito aur train — force same. Toh mosquito kyun marta hai? Ek word mein jawab do 👇
suggested_titles: "Truck aur car ki takkar — force dono par SAME hota hai 🤯" / "Newton's 3rd law: mosquito vs train"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [confidently] Chintu, truck aur car takraate hain. Truck car pe ZYADA force lagata hai. Obviously.
Chintu: [deadpan] Wrong.
Gudiya: [surprised] Kya?! Car toh chakna-choor ho jaati hai!
Chintu: [cheerfully] Ho jaati hai. Par force dono pe EXACTLY same hai. Newton ka third law. Koi exception nahi.
Gudiya: [confused] Toh car zyada kyun tooti?!
Chintu: [excited] Kyunki damage force se nahi... ACCELERATION se hota hai!
Gudiya: [curious] Matlab?
Chintu: [excited] Same force, chhota mass. a equals F by m. Car ka acceleration 10 guna zyada!
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Toh car ki speed ek jhatke mein badal jaati hai... aur truck ko kuch pata bhi nahi chalta?
Chintu: [elated] Exactly! Truck driver ko lagta hai bump aaya. Car wale ki duniya badal gayi.
Gudiya: [curious] Toh mosquito aur train?
Chintu: [laughs] Mosquito train pe UTNA hi force lagata hai jitna train mosquito pe!
Gudiya: [gasps] Sach?!
Chintu: [mischievously] Sach. Bas mosquito ka acceleration... thoda zyada hai.
Gudiya: [elated] Matlab force barabar, par nateeja mass decide karta hai!
Chintu: [proudly] Isi line ko exam mein likhna hai.
Gudiya: [curious] Toh cricket mein catch lete hue haath peeche kyun kheenchte hain?
Chintu: [mischievously] Woh next video mein!
